text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A: the uploader uploads each blob to every relay in the channel's relay list (from ChannelAdmissionKey.relays); readers fetch from any of them, falling back to the CO archive if listed; every copy verified by CID. On relay replacement the CO instructs a surviving relay or the archive to copy the channel's blobs to the new relay (relay-to-relay transfer by CID list under the ServiceAgreement; Bitswap MAY be used between these known peers). No discovery protocol; no new IO knowledge.
